svg.title: The mechanet workflow
svg.desc: Seventeen mechanet commands in three bands. On your laptop: init, generate, plan, show-cycle. On the cluster: cluster import, references, submit --pilot, submit, status, collect, select, submit --selected --through freq. Analysis: thermo, plot-profile, pathways --rank, pourbaix --plot, report.
svg.text: SLURM, VASP and your PAW files
in the project folder, once results are in
